derives_from: docs/fable5-app-integration-readiness/contracts/citation_verification_contract.json (C6, C7) and mock-harness mock_citation_scenarios (MC-01..MC-08); patterns adapted from app/src/lib/citation-validator.ts without modifying that file
pipeline: 1 extract citation strings from the model draft (TCA sections, TRJPP rules, TRE rules, DCS policy ids)
2 normalize each to the alias normal form used by lookup_citation_alias
3 resolve each against the adapter envelopes already fetched for this request; a citation not present in this request's envelopes fails even if it exists in the corpus (no out-of-band authority)
4 clamp granularity: a chunk-level envelope cannot support a subsection-level citation claim (MC-04)
5 assign verification_level per citation: verified_exact, verified_parent, unverified
6 verdict: any unverified citation, or an answer with zero citations, converts to unsupported_answer refusal (T-CIT-MISSING, MC-08)

verification_levels.verified_exact: alias resolved to the same authority_key and granularity as claimed
verification_levels.verified_parent: resolved at parent granularity; rendered citation must display the parent form, not the claimed child form
verification_levels.unverified: no resolution in this request's envelopes; fatal to the answer

rendering_rules.display: citation_display string from the adapter envelope verbatim; the model's own citation text is never rendered
rendering_rules.synthetic_marker: SYNTHETIC prefix on mock fixture citations must survive to the UI unaltered so no mock output can be mistaken for real authority (MC-06)
rendering_rules.confidence_honesty: answer confidence is capped by the weakest citation verification_level (MC-07)

audit: each request writes citation verification records: one row per citation with level and resolution ref; write failure is fail-closed per audit contract
non_goals_m1: no fuzzy matching beyond the normal form rules
no bluebook formatting engine; display strings come from envelopes
